verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime offers a free Developer Sandbox with its own API keys. The docs say it lets you safely test the API without interfering with production data, and a dedicated testing-in-sandbox guide covers command-line testing and a Postman Collection to use before going live. Missing for 10: details on simulating transfer, card or webhook events in the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration that sandbox and production are actually isolated.
